title: Turtle wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shell -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#2e8b57'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='15' fill='#3cb371'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#66cdaa'/>
  <!-- shell spots -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='58' r='3' fill='#2e8b57'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='58' r='3' fill='#2e8b57'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='3' fill='#2e8b57'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='80' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#7ac74f'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='80' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#7ac74f'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <polygon points='80,68 90,72 80,74' fill='#7ac74f'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='50' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#8fd14f'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='36' y='55' width='10' height='8' rx='3' fill='#7ac74f'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='47' r='2.6' fill='#1b3a2a'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='47' r='2.6' fill='#1b3a2a'/>
  <circle cx='25.8' cy='46.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='33.8' cy='46.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M24 53 Q29 57 34 53' stroke='#1b3a2a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='30,40 18,16 42,16' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <polygon points='30,40 24,28 36,28' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <polygon points='30,40 27,34 33,34' fill='#4fc3ff'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='15' r='4' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='21' cy='20' r='2' fill='#4fc3ff'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='20' r='2' fill='#4fc3ff'/>
</svg>
